messages:
elaine: Quick sync — I'm proposing a decisioning matrix so we can lock PRD scope for structured output + tool calling. Need concrete launch criteria by EOD Friday. Sketch below, looking for objections and owners.

matt: Question — do we treat schema validation failures as user errors (400) or as a system fallback that attempts best-effort tool output? customers are split.

devon: For regulated customers (FinCo/Acme) we must fail closed: no tool invocation if schema can't be validated. For PLG/experimental routes we can try best-effort toolcall and tag as degraded.

anika: Draft acceptance criteria I threw together: 
1) Schema-parsing success >=95% on representative eval set (per-model).
2) Fallback behavior documented + deterministic (fail-closed vs best-effort) per route.
3) Regression alerts when parse accuracy drops >3% after rollout.
4) End-to-end e2e tests for tool calls + masking for sensitive fields.

paolo: Edge cases to capture in PRD: partial parses (only some fields), extra unexpected fields, ambiguous enum values, nested arrays with mixed types. We should include explicit examples and expected normalized output per case.

lucy: QA checklist items: short fuzz harness for schema robustness, golden prompt sets from customer repros, and integration tests exercising the fallback policy. I'll own the test plan if someone can allocate time for dataset curation.

elaine: Example minimal schema (for discussion):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["create_ticket","search","none"]},
    "payload": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```
And pseudocode for validation + fallback: 
```
if validate(response, schema):
  proceed_with_tool(response)
else if route.policy == "fail-closed":
  return user_error(400, "validation_failed")
else:
  call_tool_best_effort(response)  # tag as degraded
```

matt: Two prioritization asks from field: Acme wants strict schema + audit logs (high ARR). Another midmarket customer wants richer best-effort toolcalls for search ranking. Need to capture as separate route configs in the PRD.

anika: Launch criteria proposal:
- Beta: internal + 2 customers, schema pass >=96% on beta eval set, fallback runs validated.
- GA: multi-tenant safe, SLA for response correctness loss (TBD), observability + cost estimate.

paolo: Rollout constraints: must be able to toggle route.policy without redeploy. Add feature-flagging + config API in PRD.

qa-bot: CI checklist (auto):
- unit schema tests (pass)
- integration: toolcall with valid payload (pass)
- integration: invalid payload -> fail or degraded path (pass)
- golden customer repros run nightly
- alert on schema-accuracy drop > 2%

deploy-bot: Canary plan suggestion: 1% traffic for 24h -> 10% for 48h -> 100% with rollback on regression alert. Auto-fallback to previous model variant on error spike.

elaine: Action items:
- anika: draft PRD section "Decisioning matrix & route policies" (due Tue EOD)
- devon: enumerate customer-specific constraints + example config for FinCo/Acme (due Wed)
- lucy: own QA harness + golden sets (due Thu)
- matt: sketch metrics dashboard requirements for observability (alerts, per-route schema accuracy) (due Wed)
- paolo: add feature-flag API spec to infra doc (due Tue)

elaine: If no objections, I'll mark this as the canonical scope for the PRD and start the RFC draft. :thumbsup:

matt: :thumbsup: no objections from me.

devon: Fine by me, will add the customer configs.

anika: Will start the PRD draft now.

lucy: Will sync on dataset handoff later today.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: on elaine's last message)
